explained.?: Qt toolbar help button '?'; emtk draws the same help as the 'Help' button at the top of the Settings window.
explained.blur: pyqtgraph ImageView internal (normalisation panel); no control for it is visible in the Qt window (before_tab_Movie.png), the emtk canvas has gamma and display levels instead.
explained.cividis: colormap entry of the pyqtgraph movie dock; the emtk image canvas (chisurf/emtk/image_canvas.py, shared, not editable here) offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray only. Blocked, see REPORT.md section 10.
explained.divide: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.frame: pyqtgraph ImageView time-axis widget name; the emtk movie has the 'Z slice' slider.
explained.mean: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.menu: pyqtgraph ImageView menu button, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.off: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal (time-range 'off' radio), hidden in the Qt window.
explained.operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.plasma: same as cividis: not in the emtk image canvas colormap list.
explained.roi: pyqtgraph ImageView ROI button, hidden in the Qt window (the dock was built without it).
explained.subtract: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.t: pyqtgraph ImageView axis name (time axis ruler); the emtk slider shows the frame number.
explained.timerange: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation internal, hidden in the Qt window.
explained.turbo: same as cividis: not in the emtk image canvas colormap list.
explained.x: pyqtgraph ImageView axis name; the emtk image plot labels its axes 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'.
explained.y: pyqtgraph ImageView axis name; the emtk image plot labels its axes 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'.
